# `inv_001_posted_and_unpaid.txt` with a payment whose account is `Holding`,
# an asset account the test adds to the book with no commodity.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-001"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Holding"
		memo: "Paid into holding"
